integrity: Analytical universal graph and Markov proof, with 2024 finite numerical and integer test instances, no claim of independent audit or external certification.
limitations: Only the Feres angular Markov chain for reduced rational alpha=m*pi/n, n>6m, and nongrid angles; no global position-space mixing, no spectral-gap constants, and no exceptional boundary-angle classification.
title: A unicyclic fiber theorem and an arithmetic mixing dichotomy for rational random billiards
